# FC-BGA Public Smoke and Reference Sources

No downloaded dataset is committed here. `download_public_smoke.py` downloads only the pinned BGA RAM Chips Detection version when the caller supplies `ROBOFLOW_API_KEY`.

The public data verifies script wiring only. Its labels and imaging conditions do not establish FC-BGA defect accuracy, production false-positive rate, escape rate, throughput, or site latency. Preserve source attribution and review each dataset's license before redistribution.

See `public_alternatives.md` for the public substitute source list, use boundaries, and download commands. The BGA-Balls segmentation dataset, X-ray void dataset, DeepPCB, PCB component datasets, and FPIC/FICS-PCB are research or smoke references. They are not merged into the formal seven-class 2D visible-light detector.
